backend/main.mo: Defines core types for users, questions, tests, sessions, metrics, and suggestions, initializes authorization and storage mixins, and sets up in‑memory maps for all domain entities.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence records mapping feature requirements to affected frontend files and components with confidence and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains human-written summaries of many frontend files describing recent overlay, activation, query, UI, and admin-related changes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point configuring metadata and loading MathJax along with the root container and main script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app logic handling view routing, activation lifecycle, user/profile loading, and restoration of last view with activation transitions.
frontend/src/components/AverageResultPDF: Empty placeholder component file with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/CommentSection.t: Component for listing, posting, and deleting comments on questions with admin delete support and timestamp formatting.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying attribution, disclaimer, and responsive layout.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header component showing navigation, login/logout handling, and user profile/admin-aware links.
frontend/src/components/LeaderboardSecti: Displays overall leaderboard with rank badges, highlighting the current user and supporting scrollable lists.
frontend/src/components/MathContent.tsx: Wraps MathJax rendering for inline or block math content and re-typesets on theme or content changes.
frontend/src/components/PerTestResultPDF: Empty placeholder file intended for exporting detailed per-test results to PDF.
frontend/src/components/PerTestScoreOnly: Empty placeholder file intended for exporting per-test score summaries to PDF.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Profile creation dialog collecting basic user info and saving via a mutation with validation and toasts.
frontend/src/components/QuestionDetailsD: Empty placeholder file for a dialog showing detailed question information.
Provides searchable, filterable question list with selection, admin-only deletion, and batch selection support.
frontend/src/components/ResultListPDFExp: Empty placeholder file intended for exporting result lists to PDF.
frontend/src/components/ScheduleTestDial: Dialog for setting test start/end times, validating input, and submitting schedule updates.
frontend/src/components/ShareButtons.tsx: Provides WhatsApp and Telegram share buttons that open share links and show toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/SuggestionModera: Fetches, displays, and deletes user suggestions with moderation actions and confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/components/SuggestionSectio: Allows users to submit feedback with character counting and form validation.
frontend/src/components/UserManagement.t: Empty component file with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/ViewActivationOv: Shows a fullscreen loading overlay when a specific view is being activated.
frontend/src/components/YouTubeSubscript: UI flow requiring users to subscribe to a YouTube channel and verify subscription before accessing tests.
frontend/src/contexts/ViewActivationCont: Context managing view activation state with start, finish, cancel, and timeout logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity, invalidating dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useBootstrappedCaller: Returns the user's role using cached bootstrap data and reconciles it with backend results.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, handling identity loading, login, and status tracking. Includes helpers to create an AuthClient and expose identity-related actions via a custom hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profile, role, and test-related data through an actor API. Includes conversion helpers between backend and local profile types.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables, dark mode styles, base element styling, and custom overlay behavior for Radix UI components. Ensures consistent theming and visual behavior across the app.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering the main App component. Imports global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with mission, story, and values sections, triggering view activation on mount. Uses shared layout components and styled cards for content.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Empty placeholder file intended for an Admin Panel page implementation.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Implements the dashboard page, loading user data and test configs, managing activation states, and displaying a banner plus integration notice. Includes loading skeletons and admin-role awareness.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page component with authentication check, hero section, and start-test flow tied to Internet Identity and user profile state.
frontend/src/pages/ResultPage.tsx: Empty placeholder for a results page component.
frontend/src/pages/TestInterface.tsx: Empty placeholder for the test-taking interface component.
frontend/src/types/local.ts: Local TypeScript models mirroring backend Motoko types for users, tests, questions, comments, and leaderboard data.
frontend/src/utils/questionPdfExport.ts: Placeholder for utilities to export questions to PDF (currently empty).
frontend/src/utils/roleBootstrap.ts: Persists per-principal user roles in localStorage for faster admin/user UI rendering.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/src/utils/viewPersistence.ts: Manages last-view persistence in sessionStorage for restoring navigation state.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme colors, animations, and content scanning paths.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing the stuck ViewActivationOverlay issue and related fix requirements.
